==Purpose of templates==
The '''O'''ne '''P'''ower '''S'''trength templates display [[One Power]] [[Strength in the One Power rankings|strength]] with proper formatting:

* {{t|ops}} - Merely formats and displays the strength.
* {{t|opsl}} - Also links to the level's entry in the table on the [[Strength in the One Power rankings]] page.

Generally, {{t|opsl}} is preferred.

==How to use==
 <nowiki>{{ops|</nowiki>''power''<nowiki>}}</nowiki>
 <nowiki>{{opsl|</nowiki>''power''<nowiki>}}</nowiki>

The "power" parameter is a simple integer from 1 to 78, where 1 is equivalent to ++1, 7 is equivalent to 1(+12), 19 is equivalent to 13(1), and 78 is equivalent to 72(6).
